changes: No changes needed. The quoted colophon names no person, date or place. 'śubham astu lekhapāṭhakayoḥ' is a standard blessing on the scribe and the reader. Added a note on 'amaḥ' (read 'namaḥ').

notes: The catalogue gives Dhanañjaya as the scribe, but that name, and any date, is not in the quoted colophon (fol. 303r1–2). Only the generic 'lekhapāṭhakayoḥ' appears. The scribe's name may be somewhere else in the manuscript that the cataloguer did not quote, so it can't be confirmed from this text. 'amaḥ' is a slip for 'namaḥ'. The colophon closes the upasaṃhārapāda, chapter 124.
